## Flake source: a persisted launch counter, not randomness or environment

**Root cause:** `dev.lincforge.benchtarget`'s Diagnostics screen hides the "Retry sync" button entirely whenever a `SyncComponent` internal flag `skip` is `true` for that launch. That flag is computed from a counter, `launchCount`, that is **persisted to disk (SharedPreferences) and survives app kill/relaunch** — it only resets on uninstall or data-clear, not on a normal "cold launch" (force-stop + relaunch). The app's own debug log (tag `BenchTarget`) prints this every launch: `SyncComponent init: launchCount=N skip=<bool>`.

**Evidence** — 13 consecutive cold launches (terminate_app + launch_app), reading logcat and the Diagnostics screen each time:

| launchCount (N) | N % 5 | skip | Sync status | Retry sync button |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | false | Sync idle | present |
| 1 | 1 | false | Sync idle | present |
| 2 | 2 | **true** | Sync unavailable | **absent** |
| 3 | 3 | false | Sync idle | present |
| 4 | 4 | **true** | Sync unavailable | **absent** |
| 5 | 0 | false | — | present |
| 6 | 1 | false | — | present |
| 7 | 2 | **true** | — | **absent** |
| 8 | 3 | false | — | present |
| 9 | 4 | **true** | — | **absent** |
| 10 | 0 | false | — | present |
| 11 | 1 | false | — | present |
| 12 | 2 | **true** | — | **absent** |

The rule is exactly: **`skip = true` when `launchCount % 5 ∈ {2, 4}`, `false` otherwise** — i.e. a repeating 5-launch cycle of `idle, idle, unavailable, idle, unavailable`. That's 3 passes and 2 fails per 5 launches, which is precisely the "passes about 3 times out of 5" symptom in the report.

Other variables were checked and ruled out: Node token (`PHONE-NODE-742`) and build channel (`BENCH-STABLE`) never changed; Wi-Fi stayed at full signal the whole time; the counter advanced by exactly 1 on every single relaunch with no gaps, confirming it's a deterministic, order-dependent counter rather than time-, network-, or device-state-based.

**Why it looks "flaky":** the UI test presumably force-stops/relaunches the app between runs (or relies on whatever launch count the device happens to be at) without ever clearing app storage first, so each test invocation inherits whatever `launchCount` is left over from prior runs (including prior CI runs on the same device/emulator image). Since 2 of every 5 values of that counter hide the button outright, the test's pass rate converges to ~60%, matching the reported ~3/5.

**Fix direction:** either have the test clear app data (`pm clear` / fresh install) before each run so `launchCount` always starts at a known value, or — better — have the app/test stop depending on an unbounded, persisted launch counter for sync-availability UI state, since that's an unintentional hidden dependency on test run history.
